question: What collective designation applies to Īśa, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śakti in this enumeration?
premises: Īśa and Brahmā are named as members of the set.
Viṣṇu and Śakti are likewise included in the same set.
The enumerated members are jointly designated in a stated manner.
inference: Īśa, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śakti together constitute the group identified by this designation.
uncertainties: The specific referent or title implied by the designation is not explicit within this verse alone.
plain_english: Īśa, Brahmā, and likewise Viṣṇu and Śakti are thus designated.
